name: Airfloa Rail Technology Ltd
tagline: A 20-year rolling-stock components + coach-interiors maker mid-inflection: Q1FY27 revenue +200% YoY, FY27 guidance Rs 500 Cr (+66%), and a deliberate pivot from 'railways manufacturer' to precision manufacturer for railways + aerospace & defence - @a_basumallick STOCK STORY feature.
business_overview: Incorporated 1998. Manufactures high-precision forged/machined components and interior/exterior assemblies for rolling stock (Indian Railways, metro, export coaches - Vande Bharat, Namo Bharat, Kolkata Metro) and is scaling critical components for aerospace & defence (mainly HAL; anti-drone / defence work referenced). SMERA SME-1 rating (highest). Seeded as a trusted-X lead: @a_basumallick ran a 'STOCK STORY' feature framing the railways-to-precision-A&D transition as 'a very interesting business' (x_conviction_strength: high).

~Rs 433.8 Cr (Jun-end); bid pipeline ~Rs 1,200 Cr (rail / metro / A&D)

fundamentals_narrative: The trailing 5-year revenue CAGR (~12%) is stale and misleading: FY26 grew ~66% and Q1FY27 revenue was up ~200% YoY (Rs 100.7 Cr in one quarter vs Rs 90.5 Cr for all of H1FY26), with PAT up ~69%. Management guides Rs 500 Cr FY27 revenue with 70-75% already covered by the order book and a Rs 1,200 Cr bid pipeline. ROE is ~22%. The strategic pivot - from a coach-interiors / rolling-stock vendor to a precision manufacturer also serving aerospace & defence (HAL, anti-drone) - is the re-rating lever @a_basumallick is pointing at. Valuation is ~29x trailing but ~19x FY27E earnings against ~66% growth, so PEG is well under 1. Risks: SME-scale, order-book lumpiness, a single dominant A&D customer (HAL), and the A&D ramp is guidance, not yet delivered.

verdict_headline: Genuine live inflection (Q1FY27 revenue +200%) plus a credible rail-to-A&D re-rating pivot and a trusted-X STOCK STORY feature - four_box 3.0. thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years, conviction Medium, A&D ramp unconfirmed. revisit in 30 days.
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind yes (railway capex - Vande Bharat/Namo Bharat/metro - plus defence indigenisation; Q1FY27 +200% YoY is a live inflection), tam weak (rail interiors + precision components is a modest TAM and the A&D leg is small/unproven today), moat weak (RDSO/customer qualifications + HAL approval + 20-yr track record are sticky, but fabrication is competitive), valuation yes (~19x FY27E earnings against ~66% growth - genuine room to pay) -> score 3.0

Score >= 3.0 -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted. Small/mid-cap live-inflection rule applies: the stale ~12% trailing CAGR is overridden by the FY26 +66% / Q1FY27 +200% actuals + order-book-backed FY27 guidance.

Conviction Medium: live inflection + trusted-X (a_basumallick, 'high') + reasonable valuation, but held at Medium (not higher) because the A&D ramp is guidance not yet delivered, HAL is a concentrated customer, the order-book business is lumpy and there is no independent VP scrutiny. A&D contribution marked unconfirmed.

value_chain.theme: Defence / aerospace manufacturing bottlenecks + rail rolling-stock
value_chain.position: Tier-2/3 precision forged & machined components and coach interior/exterior assemblies for Indian Railways / metro / export coaches, ramping into aerospace & defence components (HAL)
value_chain.bottleneck_node: Certified precision-machining and assembly capacity for A&D and rolling-stock, with RDSO / customer qualifications
value_chain.note: The rail-interiors base is a steady but modest market; the value-chain upgrade is the deliberate move into higher-margin A&D precision parts. That step-up - customer breadth beyond HAL, margins, order flow - is what the thesis rides on and is not yet demonstrated.
